name: B10-0106/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Further deterioration of the political situation in Georgia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the further deterioration of the political situation in Georgia
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for a new election in Georgia within a year, saying the October 2024 vote was undermined by fraud. It condemns police violence against protesters and the detention of opposition politicians and journalists, and asks for their release. It wants the European Union to sanction Georgian officials, including Bidzina Ivanishvili, and to keep funding civil society and independent media. It also asks the European Union to review its agreements with Georgia. The text is a statement of positions and requests; it does not itself change any law.

- Parliament asks for a new Georgian election within a year under international observation.
- It urges European Union sanctions on Georgian officials and release of detainees.
- It calls for more European Union money for Georgian civil society and media.
